description:
Company Name: VARITE India Private Limited

About The Client:
Client is a leading digital transformation solutions provider and IT services company with over 30,000 employees across 30+ countries. Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, it helps Fortune 500 and Global 1000 clients with digital, cloud, AI, cybersecurity, and engineering services.

 

About The Job:

  • The Project Manager will support project delivery within Engineering Services (GES), working directly with the Sr. Director, Engineering Services.
  • This role is part of the initial deployment of PMO capabilities into Engineering Services and is intended to establish a scalable model for delivery governance, execution discipline, and performance visibility beyond IT.
  • The role will initially support the Sr. Director in coordination, reporting, and governance activities, with transition to ownership of defined delivery workstreams and governance adoption activities within the first 3-6 weeks.
  • This role acts as the PMO delegate to the Sr. Director, Engineering Services, with responsibility for delivery governance, stage-gate readiness, intake quality, forecast cadence, variance visibility, and escalation across assigned initiatives.

Working Hours

  • US (EST): 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
  • India (IST): 6:30 PM - 2:30 AM

Role Scope

  • Typically supports 3-6 concurrent initiatives
  • Typical initiative duration ranges from 8-24 weeks
  • Portfolio mix may include compliance and validation activities, standards adoption, reliability and availability initiatives, operational readiness, and engineering-led improvement programs aligned to GES priorities.

Essential Job Functions:
Project Delivery

  • Own end-to-end delivery management for assigned initiatives, including planning, execution, monitoring, reporting, and closure
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and action tracking
  • Drive cross-functional alignment to ensure timely execution of deliverables and resolution of delivery risks
  • Monitor progress against scope, schedule, key risks, and agreed operational outcomes
  • End-to-end ownership includes baseline plan, RAID, change control impacts, stakeholder sign-offs, and closure with outcomes/benefits review

Governance

  • Apply PMO standards, governance requirements, and stage-gate expectations across assigned initiatives
  • Review intake submissions for completeness, quality, and alignment to defined standards before progression
  • Ensure required governance artifacts are complete and current per stage-gate expectations
  • Support adoption of structured delivery practices within Engineering Services
  • Governance forums include weekly initiative reviews and monthly steering reviews with Engineering Services leadership, or equivalent established cadence

Stage-Gate Readiness

  • Ensure stage-gate readiness through completion and review of applicable project artifacts, including:
    • Project scope and charter
    • Requirements and URS traceability, where applicable
    • RAID log and mitigation actions
    • Change control impacts
    • Validation or qualification plan, where applicable
    • Baseline schedule and milestone plan
    • Required stakeholder reviews and sign-offs

Decision Rights

  • Acts as PMO delegate for the Sr. Director, Engineering Services, with delegated governance authority
  • Has authority to hold stage-gate progression until required criteria are met
  • May reject, return, or defer intake submissions that do not meet minimum governance, documentation, or readiness requirements
  • Escalates unresolved compliance, delivery, or performance issues through established governance forums

Stakeholder Management

  • Partner closely with the Sr. Director, Engineering Services, Engineering Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and IT
  • Provide clear, timely, and structured communication on project status, decisions required, delivery risks, and mitigation actions
  • Facilitate governance reviews, status reviews, and follow-up actions across workstreams

Financial Performance Management

  • Support project forecasting, variance monitoring, and performance reporting across assigned initiatives
  • Engineering Managers retain approval authority and ownership of project budget and spend
  • The Project Manager is responsible for forecast cadence, variance visibility, and escalation of delivery or financial risks through established governance forums
  • Ensure financial reporting inputs are complete, timely, and aligned to agreed review cadences

Performance Tracking and Reporting

  • Prepare project status reports, executive summaries, governance materials, and performance updates
  • Track delivery against milestones, risks, dependencies, forecast updates, and agreed business outcomes
  • Support post-implementation review and performance tracking activities, where applicable

Qualifications:
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related field
  • PMP certification required
  • Minimum 3 years of project delivery ownership in an engineering, manufacturing, quality, or regulated operations environment
  • Demonstrated ownership of at least 2 cross-functional projects end-to-end, from planning through closure
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management across cross-functional teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning, organization, and execution discipline

Required Experience

  • Candidates must demonstrate direct delivery ownership or governance enforcement, not observation-only support, in at least one of the following areas:
    • Audit readiness support or regulatory inspection support
    • Validation or CQV activities, including digital validation platforms such as Kneat
    • Engineering standards, URS governance, or standards adoption
    • Deviation reduction, batch release time improvement, or right-first-time enablement
    • Reliability or availability programs for mission-critical assets
    • CapEx qualification support or final engineering reviews
  • These areas align directly to GES priorities across quality, compliance, reliability, operational readiness, and engineering execution.

Preferred Experience

  • Engineering, manufacturing, plant, or operations project environments
  • Cross-functional delivery involving Engineering, Quality, Operations, and IT
  • Capital project support, qualification activities, or operational improvement programs
  • Use of project or portfolio management tools such as Planview, MS Project, ServiceNow, or equivalent

Core Competencies

  • Project delivery and execution management
  • Governance and compliance discipline
  • Stakeholder management and communication
  • Risk identification, escalation, and follow-through
  • Forecast and variance reporting
  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed environment

Additional Information

  • High-visibility role with direct exposure to Engineering Services leadership
  • Requires collaboration across global teams and time zones
  • This role combines delivery ownership with governance enforcement and performance visibility

title: UI Path Solution Architect
description:
Company Name: VARITE India Private Limited

About The Client:
Client is an Indian multinational technology company specializing in information technology services and consulting. Headquartered in Mumbai, it is a part of the Tata Group and operates in 150 locations across 46 countries.

About The Job:

  • Highly experienced UiPath Solution Architect to define, drive, and scale enterprise wide RPA programs. The role requires deep UiPath technical expertise, strong people leadership, and the ability to lead and mentor a ~30member team (architects, tech leads, developers, and analysts) while partnering closely with business and IT stakeholders.
  • The architect will own RPA strategy, solution design, governance, delivery excellence, and value realization across multiple business units.

Essential Job Functions:
RPA Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Own end to end RPA solution architecture using UiPath (Studio, Orchestrator, Robots, AI Center, Insights, Automation Hub).
  • Define enterprise RPA standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks .
  • Design scalable, secure, and high availability architectures for large volume and mission critical automations.
  • Review and approve solution designs, code quality, and deployment strategies .
  • Drive adoption of advanced UiPath capabilities (RE Framework, queues, APIs, AI/ML, Document Understanding, attended & unattended bots).

Team Leadership & Delivery Management

  • Lead and manage a large RPA team (~30 members) including architects, leads, developers, and analysts.
  • Set technical direction and ensure consistent delivery quality across multiple parallel programs.
  • Build succession planning, skill development, and certification roadmaps .
  • Conduct architecture reviews, performance reviews, and technical coaching .

Program & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with business, IT, security, infrastructure, and compliance teams .
  • Translate business requirements into robust automation solutions with measurable ROI .
  • Provide executive level updates , automation roadmaps, and value tracking.
  • Manage multiple large RPA initiatives across geographies .

Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Define and enforce RPA governance model, SDLC, and change management .
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements .
  • Drive best practices for credential management, exception handling, logging, and monitoring .

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • dentify opportunities for hyper automation (RPA + AI + APIs) .
  • Evaluate new UiPath releases and emerging automation technologies .
  • Continuously improve automation efficiency, stability, and cost optimization .

Qualifications:

  • Overall Experience: 6 to 15 yrs experience | 6–8+ years in UiPath
  • Keywords Search (Must Have): UiPath + Python + Agentic AI/GenAI  (Platform Agnostic) 

Essential Skills

  •  UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, Robots
  • Enterprise RPA Architecture & RE Framework
  • Queues, APIs, Web Services
  •  SAP, Citrix, Mainframes automation
  • Exception handling, logging, performance tuning
  • RPA SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Automation Hub, AI Center, Document Understanding

Desirable Skills

  • Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS)
  • Process Mining tools and value measurement
  • Large Shared Services / Global Delivery experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • UiPath Advanced (Professional) Developer / Solution Architect Certification (mandatory)

Soft Skills

  • Strong decisionmaking and ownership mindset
  • Ability to influence senior leadership
  • Excellent people management and conflict resolution
  • Strategic thinking with a handson approach
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
